Tel +1 202 639 6041 
Fax+1 202 661-4925 
AUnikowsky@jenner.com

Re;

No. 16-1498, Washington State Department of Licensing v. Cougar Den, Inc.

Dear Mr. Harris:

We represent Respondent in Washington State Department of Licensing v. Cougar Den, Inc. The 
petition for a writ of certiorari was granted on June 25, 2018. Petitioner filed its opening brief on August 9, 
2018. Without an extension. Respondent’s brief would be due on September 10, 2018. As a result of 
counsel’s professional obligations in other matters, including merits briefs in three cases in the courts of 
appeals and post-trial briefing following a complex jury trial, we respectfully move for a one-week 
extension of time to file Respondent’s brief, to and including September 17, 2018. I have spoken to 
Petitioner’s counsel, who states that Petitioner consents to this one-week extension of time.

Sincerely,

AdamG. Unikowsky

cc; Noah Purcell, Esq.
